summary: Unlock your financial expertise with our Corporate Finance Essentials Training Course. Gain practical knowledge to excel in the corporate finance world.
lede: Corporate finance training helps finance professionals assess financial performance, investment choices, and funding needs. For analysts, finance partners, and budget managers, it builds skills in interpreting statements and ratios, evaluating investments and funding with NPV, IRR, and cost-of-capital estimates, and forecasting cash flow while managing working capital for practical recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate investments, manage cash flow, and support funding decisions in a corporate setting.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic numeracy, comfort with spreadsheets, and a working familiarity with balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements. No programming is required. Prior exposure to budgeting, management accounting, or business reporting will help, but the course is structured for foundation to intermediate learners and does not assume advanced financial modelling experience. A laptop with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is recommended for the exercises.
